title: Team Rest of the World denies Team Asia's bid for Reyes Cup three-peat
summary: Team Asia's bid for a third consecutive Reyes Cup title came to an end after Team Rest of the World claimed an 11-4 victory in the 2026 edition on Sunday at the Makati Coliseum.
